title: Bluelight Client
description: Makes the game playable, client side
body:
# Bluelight Client ## Production **Provided by:** J0T0S0
**Loader:** Fabric
**Type:** client-side vanilla optimization modpack. ## Overview Bluelight Client is a strictly performance-focused Minecraft client designed for players who want the highest possible FPS, lowest latency, and smoothest gameplay without altering the core vanilla experience. Unlike many modern “optimization” packs that gradually turn into feature bundles, Bluelight Client maintains a pure philosophy: > _If it doesn’t directly improve performance, it doesn’t belong._ This results in a clean, efficient, and distraction-free setup that feels like vanilla Minecraft, just significantly faster and more responsive. ## Why Choose Bluelight Client? ### Maximum FPS Gains Carefully selected optimization mods that target rendering, memory usage, and CPU efficiency. ### Zero Feature Bloat No minimaps, no UI overhauls, no gameplay tweaks—only performance. ### Vanilla Experience Preserved Gameplay, visuals, and mechanics remain true to Minecraft’s original design. ### Lightweight & Stable Minimal overhead ensures fast startup times and consistent performance across a wide range of systems. ### Multiplayer Friendly Fully client-side, does not interfere with the server in any way. ## FAQ **Will you add features like minimaps, HUD mods, or utilities?** No. Bluelight Client is intentionally minimal and performance-only. If you want the same optimized base with a few essential utilities, check out:
👉 [Bluelight Client Plus](https://modrinth.com/modpack/bluelight-client-plus)! ## Join the community Join our official Discord server to stay updated on our products! --- ## Need A Server? Support The Project! Running a smooth client is only half the equation, your server matters too!
